snippet.description:
Welcome to The Folklore Case Files. We crack open the classified archives of history's darkest secrets. We treat every legend, myth, and ghost story as an open investigation, blurring the line between folklore and true paranormal reality.

Forget gentle bedtime stories. This channel is a documentary journey deep into the heart of gritty American Folk Horror and high strangeness.

Inside our "case files," we analyze the evidence surrounding: Haunted Roads & Highways where travelers vanish without a trace. Ghost Towns & Abandoned Places where the echoes of the past refuse to be silenced. Lingering Battlefield Spirits and soldiers who never left their posts. Terrifying Urban Legends & Modern Myths tested against reality. Ancient Native Curses and forgotten lore.

🔴 If you are fascinated by dark history, high strangeness, liminal spaces, and the unexplained – SUBSCRIBE and open the first case file with us.

snippet.title: NOVA PBS Official
snippet.description:
Blowing your mind since 1974.

NOVA is the most-watched primetime science series on television reaching an average of five million viewers weekly. The NOVA website has been pioneering new forms of web-original content since it debuted in early 1996. NOVA's online presence amplifies the impact of its programs, with a website that garners well over a million visitors each month, and with audiences on Facebook, YouTube, Twitter, and more. NOVA's mission is to make science accessible to viewers so that they can better understand the world around them. 

NOVA is produced by GBH Boston and airs Wednesday nights at 9/8c on most PBS stations.

NOVA's content is made possible by viewers like you. Support your local PBS station here: https://pbs.org/donate/

snippet.title: WAS Popular History
snippet.description:
Welcome to WAS — your gateway to history that matters.
We create short, powerful educational videos that reveal the stories behind world-changing events, ideas, and people. At WAS, history is not just about the past — it’s a lens through which we understand today’s challenges and the foundations of democratic society.
Our mission is to promote critical thinking, inspire curiosity, and encourage viewers to engage thoughtfully with the world around them. Through dynamic storytelling, rich visuals, and carefully researched narratives, we make history accessible, entertaining, and relevant to a global audience.
Whether you’re passionate about ancient civilizations, modern revolutions, cultural movements, or the fight for human rights, you’ll find thought-provoking content here. We believe that understanding history empowers individuals to make better decisions and defend the values of freedom, equality, and justice.

From prehistoric shelters and Stone Age engineering to ancient and medieval architecture, this channel uncovers the forgotten construction techniques and survival strategies that shaped human civilization. New videos weekly exploring ancient architecture, primitive engineering, lost building knowledge, and the foundations of human innovation.

Step into a realm of forgotten expeditions, mysterious disappearances, and real survival stories taken to the extreme. Through atmospheric visuals, immersive narration, and meticulously researched cases, we revive the final steps, fears, and decisions of those who dared to challenge the wild — and never returned the same.

Subscribe to Lost Expedition Files and embark on gripping, timeless stories that reveal the fragile line between adventure and tragedy.

snippet.title: Poseidon Expeditions
snippet.description:
Poseidon Expeditions has been organizing polar cruises since 1999 and has gained tremendous expertise in the industry. 

We are passionate about old school expedition cruising, where the most important part is the time travelers spend off the ship. For this particular reason Poseidon Expeditions has chosen the expedition vessel M/V Sea Spirit, a small and intimate vessel,  which offers a truly unique polar expedition experience with a maximum of only 114 passengers onboard. This allows for personalized attention from our expert staff, and the opportunity to explore remote locations, free from the crowds and noise of larger vessels.

Whether you seek to explore the Arctic with destinations like Greenland, Svalbard, the British Isles and Iceland or venture to the White Continent to see Antarctica, South Georgia and the Falkland Islands, we know how to make this adventure the trip of a lifetime. Can’t decide where to go? Watch our videos and get inspired!

Survival Instinct — Cinematic Documentaries of Real Survival and Exploration

At Survival Instinct, we bring to life true stories of endurance, exploration, and human courage. From shipwrecks and lost expeditions to jungle survival and polar disasters, every film is based on real events — meticulously researched and told with cinematic realism.

These are not legends or fantasies, but real accounts of people who faced the impossible — surviving against nature, isolation, and fate itself. Each episode combines authentic history, immersive sound design, and stunning visuals to capture the essence of survival when all hope seems lost.

Subscribe to rediscover the forgotten chapters of human endurance and experience true documentary storytelling.
